translations.web: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
translations.bsb: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
translations.kjv: BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
